text: I am kindly asking for your support of my motion to authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) along Blandford Street, between Hanson Road and Rogers Road. Residents of Blandford Street submitted a petition to my office requesting the installation of speed humps to help reduce speeding, discourage cut-through traffic and improve the safety of their street. I have heard concern from neighbours regarding excessive speeding on Blandford Street, as cars use the street as a shortcut from Oakwood Ave to Rogers Road. With the passage of this motion, the community will receive the traffic calming measures they have been organizing for.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (two speed humps) on Blandford Street, between Hanson Road to Rogers Road, generally as shown on Attachment 2 to the letter (July 8, 2026) from Councillor Josh Matlow.
